meta.resampling_unit: report (case); all condition labels of a resampled report kept together
meta.interval: percentile 95% over defined replicates; undefined-replicate count reported
meta.wilson: 95% Wilson score interval per condition (cases treated as independent)
meta.f1_definition: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); undefined only when denominator is 0 (plan section 6.2)
